module_summary: IP frame multiplexer: on frame start latches the select input, registers the chosen source's IP header fields, and passes its AXI-stream payload through a skid-buffered output register until tlast.

anchors.name: select_reg
anchors.why: Latched input port index steering all payload current_s_* muxes

anchors.name: frame_reg
anchors.why: Frame-in-progress flag; blocks new header grab and gates payload valid

anchors.name: select
anchors.why: External port select picking header fields and latched into select_reg

anchors.name: enable
anchors.why: Enables starting a new frame transfer

anchors.name: s_ip_hdr_valid
anchors.why: Per-input header valid; selected bit starts a frame

anchors.name: s_ip_hdr_ready
anchors.why: One-hot header ready back to the selected input

anchors.name: m_ip_hdr_valid
anchors.why: Output header valid, set when header latched, cleared by hdr_ready

anchors.name: m_ip_hdr_ready
anchors.why: Downstream header ready clearing m_ip_hdr_valid_reg

anchors.name: m_ip_dest_ip
anchors.why: Representative registered output header field selected from inputs

anchors.name: s_ip_dest_ip
anchors.why: Representative packed per-input header field sliced by select

anchors.name: s_ip_payload_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Packed per-input payload data muxed by select_reg

anchors.name: s_ip_payload_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Per-input payload valid muxed into current_s_tvalid

anchors.name: s_ip_payload_axis_tready
anchors.why: Payload ready shifted to selected input during a frame

anchors.name: s_ip_payload_axis_tlast
anchors.why: Selected tlast ends the frame and clears frame flag

anchors.name: m_ip_payload_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Registered output payload data

anchors.name: m_ip_payload_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Output payload valid from skid-buffer output register

anchors.name: m_ip_payload_axis_tready
anchors.why: Downstream ready controlling skid-buffer transfers and early ready

anchors.name: current_s_tdata
anchors.why: Muxed payload data from the selected input

anchors.name: m_ip_payload_axis_tdata_reg
anchors.why: Output payload register loaded from int or temp path

anchors.name: temp_m_ip_payload_axis_tdata_reg
anchors.why: Skid-buffer temp register holding a beat when output stalls

anchors.name: m_ip_payload_axis_tready_int_reg
anchors.why: Registered internal ready deciding output vs temp storage

anchors.name: store_axis_int_to_output
anchors.why: Load enable for output payload registers from internal path

groups.name: Frame select control
groups.description: Latches select and tracks frame-in-progress from header accept to tlast

groups.name: Header mux and register
groups.description: Selects one input's header fields into output header registers with valid/ready

groups.name: Payload mux
groups.description: Muxes selected input payload stream into internal datapath

groups.name: Output skid buffer
groups.description: Two-register skid buffer driving the output payload AXI stream
